Subject: AceTech Exec Workshop — Field Safety SOP & Rapid Response Flow

Team / Sara —

Following up on the onsite prep for next month in Austin. I pulled together a concise field safety SOP and a rapid-response flow we should adopt for the two-day executive workshop. This is intended to be a lightweight single-page operational playbook that local ops and attending execs can reference during the event. Key constraints: minimal on-site medical staff, multiple offsite dinners, and one planned factory floor visit.

Please review the attached site map and local emergency contacts, and confirm the following by EOD Monday:
- Point lead for on-site incidents (medical / security)
- Local clinic / urgent care window (hours) and transportation plan
- Oncall rotation for Redwood responders (phone escalation + backup)
- Evacuation assembly point and patient transport option (ambulance vs rideshare)

Attachments: [Attachment: site-map.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [Attachment: local-emergency-contacts.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

I want one consolidated short doc we can share with Acme security and their facilities lead. Sara — if you have any site-specific advisories we should bake in (road closures, construction, local hot spots), flag them here.

Thanks,
Michael

Agree with Michael — quick notes from Logistics:

1) On-site incident lead: Stephanie will be primary, Lauren backup, Michael executive escalation. I'll own the oncall rota.
2) Local clinic: Trinity Med Urgent Care (walk-in M–F 08:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–16:00). After-hours we route to St. Mary’s ER (5 miles).
3) Transport: preferred is company shuttle for minor injuries; ambulance (911) for anything involving loss of consciousness, suspected fracture, head injury, or chest pain. We will prebook an Uber Health account for non-emergency transports as fallback.
4) Med kit: I recommend a small event kit (A, B, C) — see list below — and adding two epi-pens to the kit.

Quick med-kit checklist (event kit A — 1 per 50 people):
- Basic first aid (bandages, antiseptic)
- Thermometer, pulse oximeter
- OTC analgesics, antiemetic, antihistamine
- Two epi-pens (check expiry)
- CPR mask and disposable gloves

I attached an oncall calendar draft and marked Stephanie/Laura for primary coverage on Day 1/Day 2. I can convert this to an ICS invite once Michael confirms scope.

Attachment: [Attachment: oncall-rotation.ics (iCal, 2KB)]

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen

- The factory tour will require steel-toe boots; Acme will provide, and safety glasses are mandatory. Please add that to the SOP.
